**BVDY*** is an intervention code used in the Danish healthcare system to track and measure the quality of patient care. Specifically, it is designated for "educational interventions not classified elsewhere" (pædagogiske handlinger ikke klassificeret andetsteds) and includes all associated subcodes [^src1]. 

Within the national clinical quality development framework for cardiovascular diseases managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), BVDY* is utilized to monitor patient education for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. To ensure standardized data collection and regional comparison, this code is deployed alongside other specific intervention codes, namely [[bfkb|BFKB]] (which covers patient education in atrial fibrillation and flutter), [[bqf-star|BQF*]], and [[bvds|BVDS]] [^src1].
